macros.name: pmdBrick
macros.doc: \pmdBrick is simply a wrapper for a single brick that calls \pmdDiagram with no diagram options.

macros.name: pmdEquiv
macros.doc: draws an equivalence relation determined by arbitrarily many equivalence bricks separated by dots.

macros.name: pmdSetDefault
macros.doc: sets the default style of all diagrams and has the syntax \pmdSetDefault{<keys>}, where the input keys are one of the following: • brick – see Section 5.1, • NTedges – non-transversal edges, see Section 5.2.1, • Tedges – transversal edges, see Section 5.2.2, • brace – see Section 5.3, • bracket – see Section 5.4, • diagram – see Section 5.5.

macros.name: pmdSetToOriginalDefault
macros.doc: sets the style of all diagrams to the default original style of the package.
